verses.en: Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:
verses.pt: Ouvi isto, vós todos os povos; inclinai os ouvidos, todos os habitantes do mundo,
verses.en_web: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
verses.en_bbe: <Alamoth. To the chief music-maker. Of the sons of Korah. A Psalm.> Give attention to this, all you peoples; let your ears be open, all you who are living in the world.

verses.en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
verses.pt: quer humildes quer grandes, tanto ricos como pobres.
verses.en_web: both low and high, rich and poor together.
verses.en_bbe: High and low together, the poor, and those who have wealth.

verses.en: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.
verses.pt: A minha boca falará a sabedoria, e a meditação do meu coração será de entendimento.
verses.en_web: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart shall utter understanding.
verses.en_bbe: From my mouth will come words of wisdom; and in the thoughts of my heart will be knowledge.

verses.en: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
verses.pt: Inclinarei os meus ouvidos a uma parábola; decifrarei o meu enigma ao som da harpa.
verses.en_web: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will open my riddle on the harp.
verses.en_bbe: I will put my teaching into a story; I will make my dark sayings clear with music.

verses.en: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
verses.pt: Por que temeria eu nos dias da adversidade, ao cercar-me a iniqüidade dos meus perseguidores,
verses.en_web: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?
verses.en_bbe: What cause have I for fear in the days of evil, when the evil-doing of those who are working for my downfall is round about me?

verses.en: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
verses.pt: dos que confiam nos seus bens e se gloriam na multidão das suas riquezas?
verses.en_web: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
verses.en_bbe: Even of those whose faith is in their wealth, and whose hearts are lifted up because of their stores.

verses.en: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
verses.pt: Nenhum deles de modo algum pode remir a seu irmão, nem por ele dar um resgate a Deus,
verses.en_web: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, no man may get back his soul for a price, or give to God the payment for himself;

verses.en: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
verses.pt: (pois a redenção da sua vida é caríssima, de sorte que os seus recursos não dariam;)
verses.en_web: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,
verses.en_bbe: (Because it takes a great price to keep his soul from death, and man is not able to give it.)

verses.en: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.
verses.pt: para que continuasse a viver para sempre, e não visse a cova.
verses.en_web: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.
verses.en_bbe: So that he might have eternal life, and never see the underworld.

verses.en: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.pt: Sim, ele verá que até os sábios morrem, que perecem igualmente o néscio e o estúpido, e deixam a outros os seus bens.
verses.en_web: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
verses.en_bbe: For he sees that wise men come to their end, and foolish persons of low behaviour come to destruction together, letting their wealth go to others.

verses.en: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.
verses.pt: O pensamento íntimo deles é que as suas casas são perpétuas e as suas habitações de geração em geração; dão às suas terras os seus próprios nomes.
verses.en_web: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.
verses.en_bbe: The place of the dead is their house for ever, and their resting-place through all generations; those who come after them give their names to their lands.

verses.en: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.
verses.pt: Mas o homem, embora esteja em honra, não permanece; antes é como os animais que perecem.
verses.en_web: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.
verses.en_bbe: But man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.

verses.en: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.pt: Este é o destino dos que confiam em si mesmos; o fim dos que se satisfazem com as suas próprias palavras.
verses.en_web: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: This is the way of the foolish; their silver is for those who come after them, and their children get the pleasure of their gold. (Selah.)

verses.en: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
verses.pt: Como ovelhas são arrebanhados ao Seol; a morte os pastoreia; ao romper do dia os retos terão domínio sobre eles; e a sua formosura se consumirá no Seol, que lhes será por habitação.
verses.en_web: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.
verses.en_bbe: Death will give them their food like sheep; the underworld is their fate and they will go down into it; their flesh is food for worms; their form is wasted away; the underworld is their resting-place for ever.

verses.en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
verses.pt: Mas Deus remirá a minha alma do poder do Seol, pois me receberá.
verses.en_web: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: But God will get back my soul; for he will take me from the power of death. (Selah.)

verses.en: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.pt: Não temas quando alguém se enriquece, quando a glória da sua casa aumenta.
verses.en_web: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear when wealth comes to a man, and the glory of his house is increased;

verses.en: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
verses.pt: Pois, quando morrer, nada levará consigo; a sua glória não descerá após ele.
verses.en_web: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.
verses.en_bbe: For at his death, he will take nothing away; his glory will not go down after him.

verses.en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
verses.pt: Ainda que ele, enquanto vivo, se considera feliz e os homens o louvam quando faz o bem a si mesmo,
verses.en_web: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—
verses.en_bbe: Though he might have pride in his soul in his life-time, and men will give you praise if you do well for yourself,

verses.en: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
verses.pt: ele irá ter com a geração de seus pais; eles nunca mais verão a luz
verses.en_web: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.
verses.en_bbe: He will go to the generation of his fathers; he will not see the light again.

verses.en: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.
verses.pt: Mas o homem, embora esteja em honra, não permanece; antes é como os animais que perecem.
verses.en_web: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.
verses.en_bbe: Man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.
